title: DataGapReport
description: Phase 23 / Stage 0 deterministic output. Diffs a DataRequirementsSpec against the latest DB/dataset inventory and reports have/partial/missing per data class, with acquisition cost estimates, for the human acquire-vs-proceed gate. This report NEVER triggers a download; the human decides.

requirements_ref.description: Path/URI of the DataRequirementsSpec that was diffed.

catalog_ts.description: generated_at of the data_capability.json snapshot used (catalog-tier checks).

inventory_ref.description: Path/URI or version hash of the DB/dataset inventory file compared against.

items.description: One entry per data class in the requirements spec.

required.description: true = model run is invalid without it; false = nice-to-have.

coverage.description: What is present — a summary string (legacy path) or the catalog-backed detail object {table, date_range, missing_instruments, missing_fields}.

criticality.description: v2 (ADR-025): impact on plan feasibility — 5 = plan-blocking, 1 = cosmetic. Items are ranked by this.

acquisition.description: Estimate for acquiring missing data. Never acted on automatically — the human decides.

summary.description: Roll-up driving the gate. Proceed cleanly only when n_required_missing == 0.

n_model_missing.description: v2: proposed model families/ensemble kinds with no runnable implementation.

n_feature_unknown.description: v2: feature selections that reference unknown views/prefixes.

recommendation.description: Advisory only. The human makes the binding call. revise_plan (v2) = the plan references models/features the system cannot run.

model_coverage.description: v2 (ADR-025): every proposed model family / ensemble kind vs src/models/catalog.py + the objective's eligible_model_families pin.

feature_coverage.description: v2 (ADR-025): feature-selection hints vs feature_views.py + the capability catalog's parquet feature groups.

human_decision.description: Filled in after the operator decides at the gate.
